import json, os, math
base='/work/inputs'
with open(os.path.join(base,'inputs.json')) as f:
    mapping=json.load(f)
def load_full(mid):
    fn=mapping[mid]
    path=fn if os.path.isabs(fn) else os.path.join(base,fn)
    with open(path) as f:
        return json.load(f)
def load(mid):
    d=load_full(mid)
    return d['value'] if isinstance(d,dict) and 'value' in d else d
lengths=load('m_6d741c755eee')
times=load('m_60a564f0bb2e')
short_full=load_full('m_87834279f7e0')
short_val=short_full['value'] if isinstance(short_full,dict) else short_full
pairs=sorted(zip(times,lengths))
first3=pairs[:3]
def ols(x,y):
    n=len(x); mx=sum(x)/n; my=sum(y)/n
    sxx=sum((a-mx)**2 for a in x)
    sxy=sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(x,y))
    slope=sxy/sxx; inter=my-slope*mx
    resid=[b-(inter+slope*a) for a,b in zip(x,y)]
    s2=sum(r*r for r in resid)/(n-2) if n>2 else 0.0
    se=math.sqrt(s2/sxx) if sxx>0 and n>2 else 0.0
    return slope,se
slope,se=ols([p[0] for p in first3],[p[1] for p in first3])
# points strictly before short value
before=[p for p in pairs if p[0] < short_val]
slope_b,se_b=ols([p[0] for p in before],[p[1] for p in before]) if len(before)>=3 else (slope,se)
os.makedirs('/work/outputs',exist_ok=True)
outs={
 'win_first3_start': (first3[0][0],'recorded time of first point in early window'),
 'win_first3_end': (first3[-1][0],'recorded time of last point in early window'),
 'speed_first3_recheck': (slope,'OLS slope over first three points'),
 'speed_before_short': (slope_b,'OLS slope over points with time before the recorded short time'),
 'count_before_short_time': (before[-1][0] if before else first3[-1][0],'recorded time of last point before the short'),
}
for name,(val,method) in outs.items():
    unc_val=se if 'speed_first3' in name else (se_b if 'speed_before' in name else None)
    if unc_val is None:
        unc={'value':None,'kind':'none','method':method}
    else:
        unc={'value':unc_val,'kind':'std','method':method}
    with open(f'/work/outputs/{name}.json','w') as f:
        json.dump({'value':val,'uncertainty':unc},f)
